type.description: The gyroscope type. Use "custom" for a gyro this generator doesn't have a built-in option for; SwerveParser skips creating a gyro device for "custom" and expects the SwerveDriveConfig you pass to SwerveParser.createSwerveDrive(...)/createSwerveDriveDevices(...) to already have .withGyro(...) (and optionally .withGyroOffset(...)/.withGyroVelocity(...)) set.

id.description: CAN ID of the Gyroscope. If no CAN ID is needed, set this to 0. Ignored when type is "custom".

canbus.description: Name of the CAN bus that the Gyroscope is connected to. "" for the default CAN bus. Ignored when type is "custom".

gyroAxis.description: The axis to use for the robot heading. Default is yaw.

modules.description: Swerve module JSON files under the 'modules/' directory.
